integrity: The revised surviving claim comprises an all-field kernel-bracket conservation law and the geometry of two positive-rank strata. Exact finite-field rank polynomials and their isotropic parametrization are previously published and not newly claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary derivations only; no restricted derivation condition.
Square-zero composition only, not arbitrary nilpotency.
Local closed smooth strata; no statement of irreducible components of the nonreduced variety.
Earlier 2026-10-18 results establish the finite-field rank polynomial; new scope only the geometric/kernel conclusions.
Historical priority is qualified by plausible wider symplectic nilpotent orbit literature.
title: Kernel-bracket conservation and rank-stratum geometry for square-zero Heisenberg derivations
